summary: Observation sheets for investigation {{PRJ0117:project_id}}, the AP02 discovery genotoxicity battery for {{PRJ0117:client_variant}}. The cohort comprises {{PRJ0117:n_compounds}} articles; each assay table retains its own reporting scope. The bacterial outcome is {{PRJ0117:ames.outcome}}; displayed micronucleus frequencies do not show a consistent increase over matched vehicles. A focused follow-up was commissioned, but these sheets alone do not establish the basis for the reported bacterial and mammalian discordance or a GLP conclusion.

sheets.name: HepG2 viability
rows: HepG2 viability screen (ATP content), 24 h and 48 h exposure. Investigation OT-08-S0114.

sheets.name: Ames
rows: Bacterial mutation assay with and without S9. Mean revertants per plate, n=3. Fold is against the vehicle control on the same strain.
Control validity: positive-control responses and acceptance decisions are not tabulated here; consult the original investigation records before interpreting the outcome.

sheets.name: Micronucleus
rows: Mammalian-cell micronucleus assessment (TK6). Treatments: 3 h with S9, 3 h without S9 and 24 h without S9. Percent micronucleated cells; relative population doubling (RPD) against matched vehicle.

Displayed frequencies do not show a consistent concentration-related increase over matched vehicles. Article attribution and control acceptance must be checked in the investigation records before interpretation.
